headline: Cantor Fitzgerald Maintains Neutral on UDR, Raises Price Target to $41
summary: Cantor Fitzgerald  analyst Richard Anderson   maintains UDR (NYSE:UDR) with a Neutral and raises the price target from $39 to $41.
